chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam and al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Qasrī, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: I fear that we may perform salat on Friday before the sun passes the meridian. He said: “That is only upon the muʾadhdhins.”

key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ: the callers to prayer who are responsible for announcing the prayer time
key_terms.تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun passes the meridian, marking the entrance of noon prayer time
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, specifically in the context of the Friday salat

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible if the Friday salat is feared to be performed before the sun's zenith?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a concern about performing the Friday salat before the sun's zenith. The Imam عليه السلام clarifies that responsibility for announcing the proper time rests upon the muʾadhdhins, indicating a practical legal point regarding the timing of congregational worship.
